description: Source file implementing Vulkan tensor copy operations and utility functions for the PyTorch library, including memory transfer between CPU and Vulkan GPU tensors.

classes.name: VulkanImpl
classes.description: Implementation of Vulkan tensor operations interface for PyTorch, providing Vulkan availability check and tensor copy functionality.

methods.name: memcpy_to_mapping
methods.description: Copies data from a Tensor to a Vulkan memory mapping based on data type.

methods.name: memcpy_from_mapping
methods.description: Copies data from a Vulkan memory mapping to a Tensor based on data type.

methods.name: transfer_cpu_to_vulkan
methods.description: Transfers data from CPU tensor to Vulkan tensor.

methods.name: transfer_vulkan_to_cpu
methods.description: Transfers data from Vulkan tensor to CPU tensor.

methods.name: transfer_vulkan_to_vulkan
methods.description: Copies data between two Vulkan tensors.

methods.name: pack_cpu_to_vulkan
methods.description: Copies data from CPU tensor to Vulkan tensor using compute shaders.

methods.name: pack_vulkan_to_cpu
methods.description: Copies data from Vulkan tensor to CPU tensor using compute shaders.

methods.name: copy_
methods.description: Performs in-place copy between tensors, handling Vulkan and CPU tensors.

methods.name: to_vulkan
methods.description: Converts a CPU tensor to a Vulkan tensor.

methods.name: from_vulkan
methods.description: Converts a Vulkan tensor to a CPU tensor.
